mapper.select: SELECT asset.* , ifnull(SUM(sub.SMV),0) UNINVEST_CASH, GREATEST(asset.UPDATE_TIME1,ifnull(asset.UPDATE_TIME2,asset.UPDATE_TIME1)) UPDATE_TIME FROM (SELECT sub.VAL_DATE POS_DATE, sub.PTL_ID PLAN_ASSET_ID, info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID ASSET_CODE, info2.REP_CCY CCY, ifnull(SUM(sub.SECURITY_QUANTITY),0)*(case fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 when 'F01' then 100 else 1 end) POS_NUM, ifnull(SUM(sub.SMV),0) POS_AMT, sumsub.TOTAL_NUM TOTAL_NUM, max(ifnull(sub.CREATE_TIME,sub.UPDATE_TIME)) UPDATE_TIME1, sumsub.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME2 FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB sub /*获取底层资产的公开市场代码*/ LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_DEPT info ON info.REP_FINPROD_ID = sub.FINPROD_ID /*判断是否为债券*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = sub.FINPROD_ID /*获取资管计划币种*/ LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_DEPT info2 ON info2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = sub.PTL_ID /*判断资管计划是否存在*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp2 ON fp2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = sub.PTL_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT ifnull(SUM(SMV),0) TOTAL_NUM, VAL_DATE, PTL_ID, max(ifnull(CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_TIME)) UPDATE_TIME FROM RSK_VALTBL_SUM_ASSET_SUB WHERE SUB_CODE = '601' GROUP BY VAL_DATE, PTL_ID ) sumsub ON sumsub.VAL_DATE = sub.VAL_DATE AND sub.PTL_ID = sumsub.PTL_ID WHERE 1 =1 AND sub.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND sub.FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL --AND info2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID IS NOT NULL and fp2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID is not null GROUP BY sub.VAL_DATE, sub.PTL_ID, info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, sumsub.TOTAL_NUM, info2.REP_CCY, fp.FINPROD_TYPE2, sumsub.UPDATE_TIME ) asset LEFT JOIN RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB sub ON sub.VAL_DATE = asset.POS_DATE AND sub.PTL_ID = asset.PLAN_ASSET_ID AND sub.SUB_CODE IN ('10020101','1031','1021') GROUP BY asset.POS_DATE, asset.PLAN_ASSET_ID, asset.ASSET_CODE, asset.POS_NUM, asset.POS_AMT, asset.TOTAL_NUM, asset.CCY, asset.UPDATE_TIME1, asset.UPDATE_TIME2

MERGE INTO CHB_BOT_AST_POS CII USING (
SELECT #{item.posId,jdbcType=CHAR} POS_ID, #{item.issuePartyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ISSUE_PARTY_ID, #{item.posDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} POS_DATE, #{item.planAssetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PLAN_ASSET_ID, #{item.assetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ASSET_CODE, #{item.totalNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} TOTAL_NUM, #{item.issueAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} ISSUE_AMT, #{item.uninvestCash,jdbcType=DECIMAL} UNINVEST_CASH, #{item.posNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} POS_NUM, #{item.posAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} POS_AMT, #{item.isfinaplan,jdbcType=CHAR} ISFINAPLAN, #{item.ischl,jdbcType=CHAR} ISCHL, #{item.workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WORKFLOW_ID, #{item.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS, #{item.orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORG_CODE, #{item.deptCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DEPT_CODE, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT , NOW() CREATE_TIME, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, NOW() UPDATE_TIME, #{item.datasource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DATASOURCE FROM DUAL
) TEMP
ON(CII.PLAN_ASSET_ID = TEMP.PLAN_ASSET_ID and CII.ASSET_CODE = TEMP.ASSET_CODE and CII.POS_DATE = TEMP.POS_DATE)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.POS_ID = TEMP.POS_ID, CII.ISSUE_PARTY_ID = TEMP.ISSUE_PARTY_ID, CII.TOTAL_NUM = TEMP.TOTAL_NUM, CII.ISSUE_AMT = TEMP.ISSUE_AMT, CII.UNINVEST_CASH = TEMP.UNINVEST_CASH, CII.POS_NUM = TEMP.POS_NUM, CII.POS_AMT = TEMP.POS_AMT, CII.ISFINAPLAN = TEMP.ISFINAPLAN, CII.ISCHL = TEMP.ISCHL, CII.WORKFLOW_ID = TEMP.WORKFLOW_ID, CII.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS, CII.ORG_CODE = TEMP.ORG_CODE, CII.DEPT_CODE = TEMP.DEPT_CODE, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.DATASOURCE = TEMP.DATASOURCE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (POS_ID, ISSUE_PARTY_ID, POS_DATE, PLAN_ASSET_ID, ASSET_CODE, TOTAL_NUM, ISSUE_AMT, UNINVEST_CASH, POS_NUM, POS_AMT, ISFINAPLAN, ISCHL, WORKFLOW_ID, STATUS, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, DATASOURCE) VALUES( TEMP.POS_ID, TEMP.ISSUE_PARTY_ID, TEMP.POS_DATE, TEMP.PLAN_ASSET_ID, TEMP.ASSET_CODE, TEMP.TOTAL_NUM, TEMP.ISSUE_AMT, TEMP.UNINVEST_CASH, TEMP.POS_NUM, TEMP.POS_AMT, TEMP.ISFINAPLAN, TEMP.ISCHL, TEMP.WORKFLOW_ID, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.ORG_CODE, TEMP.DEPT_CODE, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.DATASOURCE )
